Free XML EPG TV Guide URL

!!! MERGE IS HAPPENING !!!

April 19th 2026 - We are currently (FINALLY!) undergoing a huge change in files and logic of how everything internally works. These changes and developments currently make this site unstable. We try to minimize the amount of damage we do, but history has shown us we break quite a lot each major upgrade :) It all takes some time to fix bugs and make small changes for things to run more efficiently. We already apologize for any inconvenience! You can (for the moment) still use and select the old files, but because of all the changes maybe this is not the best time to start making a config that takes a lot of your time so we can break it soon... Changes in our Crazy Web App can cause that it doesn't want to load or gives errors. The solution is to CLEAR YOUR CACHE! You can do this in Firefox for example by clicking on the little lock left to the URL, there you can find to clear all site data. Afterwards close your browser completely, so also all other windows, re-open it and login again. Pressing F12 when on our page to enter browser development mode, going to the storage tab and deleting there all open-epg cache storage, cookies, indexed db, local storage and session storage may also work wonders.

Here you find our FREE public XML EPG TV guides, sorted by country.
You can point to these files directly using the xml or xml.gz link.
(They are the same but the .gz file is compressed so smaller and faster to download, but less compatible. If you are unsure, use the normal xml file.)

These files contain 2 days of EPG data, and can be downloaded each up to 20x/day, but please don't.
We only update these files once a day and so should you, somewhere around 20:00 CET

You see for each guide the number of channels which you can click to see what these channels are.
You see next to each guide how "Fresh" this file is, hopefully in green and today's date

If you are looking for a better way to manage these files, don't even bother with this list:
Have a look at our Crazy EPG Web App and immediately start with your own personal EPG file
